before_entry.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。 理论接续区分发现已有根据、形成新生活与理由、修订评价承诺；学习后的赞同不独自认证形成过程。 在已完成的伦理学习基础上，新增比较接口辨明理由内容扩展后旧判断的传递、不可比及有前提的反转。 评价扩展进一步区分共同改善与各应用分别否定；旧内容保持不要求旧评价永久保持。 理论接续给出生活实现、支承与进一步形成的具体根据；共同生活不能以组织规模或产出代替。 后天形成的支承可以因其在基本生活中的实际作用取得保护；生成的评价须包括其形成的后续支持要求。 形成出的生活、承受和参与可以改变原服务角色的伦理根据；考虑、责任与支配权限分列。 新增取得记录到路线必要性分类的连接：忠实读取与选项覆盖支持有范围的判断，一个真实替代即可推翻不可替代性；缩小有根据解释与扩大可行选项分列。 自我评估的选择现在有精确覆盖条件：允许有根据的压缩，区分当前菜单与任意菜单；有限成功不能独自担保新范围，全域结构加辨别记录提供正面出路。 理论接续说明理解怎样实际参与目的和准备：关切可以与报酬及其他正当动机并存，其形成条件也须接受同一规范评价。 BC1 在同等基本救助的既定范围内支持保全更多生活；BC2 的一对一说明以可避免的实际毁损给出比较理由，区分境况、保护与时机，并保留机会争议。 形成中的评估区分当前能力、过去能力及形成方法。Ren 后续指出，历史区别无法恢复，不阻止以未来事件取得同一内容的新根据或修订理解；情境把握与风险估计可支持继续生成。 实际调查现接入描述与读取的共同修订：同一事件在某项估计中排除，不抹去其他有根据的表达意义；纠正归属与保留参与、支持可以属于同一回应。 关切发展接续具体化真实根据保留、改变及新形成时的双向纠正，并将学习中取得的解释纳入形成账户；五条候选路线保留各自正面作用。 按后续指示完成路线比较：以已有局部关切取得新关系内容并重组目的为理论主线，配套形成史判别，再选择机制研究；认识进步与实际新理由不以价值权重增加为定义。 LC 接通数量与程度共同改善的有限损失比较理由：实际损失的有根据匹配及额外保护可以共同支持方向；重复描述不增加生活，共同依存须进入损失判断。 情境风险接续区分个别改善与共同失效；精确有限界限允许部分把握和正风险，支持关系修订可解除共同中断，同时保留分散损失。 有限合并接续区分抵偿限制与理由删除：最强层过滤可在增加实际基本保护后翻转选择；固定比较与局部胜出拼接的条件分别公开。 关切内容形成现有一条具体候选：已有局部关切使粗略成功与实际回应的分离取得实践意义，关系辨别通过计划修订改变目的；实际新生活及对它的动机取得分列。 LR 为同等多救的充分优先提出局部稳定承诺，使一部分稍不等的基本损失有正面比较；新增共同保护另可逐次保留旧保护，增加原先冲突的实现。 同等基本风险分担RS现有正面理由：完整损失分布相当时，减轻无根据的暴露集中；同频率选择可产生不同真实风险，新信息也能支持进一步改规则。 现实市场与互联网为 enshittification 的机制追踪提供事件：以既有外部性解释为起点，查优势怎样改变未来选择及纠正条件，不将增长与损失并存当作新发现。 机会修订接续表明：最终保护的完整联合分布相同仍可能撤销正当安顿；选择规则须保留仍有效的历史要求，并说明真实纠正的根据。 陌生与无回报的关切扩展现有两段条件性说明：辨明对方在自身参与之外的生活，再取得陌生处境中的相关根据；共同史是形成入口，不是全部关切的边界。 CP为不等且未被充分排除的基本请求提出真实正机会要求，将共同分配权限与基本回应关系相连；它是新增且可争辩的进入承诺。 陌生生活辨认现接通具体实现、支撑关系、可修订证据与有限回应；观察与分类方式也可因遗漏的生活根据而修订。 共同接口史进一步支持直接经营控制与有偿影响的区分：反馈和替代的出现也可能进入维持优势的规则调整，改革需追踪实际控制关系。 RSL进一步提出有根据分担判断的有限延续；中间混合方案降低极端取舍，修订须携带理由及其整体适用范围。 风险接续新增 NP 候选：相同基本要求下，微小暴露差距不自动获得固定额外优先；在真实细分可行范围内，有条件地反对有损的精确均衡。 初次共同接管的机会限制现可连接到J3：先明确仍有效承担所保护的具体支持，再检验新安排是否兑现；名义正机会不独自完成接管任务。 选择压力下的关切现有个人补救—依存取得—共同支持—实际评定—接替的条件性形成说明；旧分数、真实损失及行动条件分别辨明。 退化边界续研区分伦理损失、返回机制与状态域：原市场模型中纠正余量精确决定统一门槛保护及指定低区证书的存在，同参数仍可保留良性域。 取得权力后的关切现有根据—有限授权—有内容的接替—可实行复核的条件性说明；充分比较可要求改变或结束原掌权方式。 随后新增实际Lean连接：具体强维护的逐情形覆盖导出同律保护质量下界；全非负自然数权重的保持刻画覆盖，一项实际法则同成功率仍可失履行。 情境把握新增有条件的估计—保留误差界—行动根据连接：变化中可收敛或有界追踪，具有正比较余量时可在有限阶段取得充分认证。 纠正入口现有由共同准备、有限授权与实际承接形成的有限候选；正当回应可跨过不愿纠正的协调者，动机取得与回应实现分别说明。 风险条件接续要求同时交代当前支持的概率对应与仍有效历史；固定旧分数或不断重算分数都不足以完成规则对齐。 指定维护新增实际执行组合：已有观察分支选择器取得真实读数并实施，经明确任务效果对应导出履行及质量下界；有限预算中旧维护仍可行而完整扩展失败，增资后付费读取或实际并行均能扩展保护。 取得的行动响应可进入预测，补偿持续变化；精度须与行动幅度共同判断，有限相关条件可联合达到足够认证，扩展前沿仍可有新未明关系。 依 Ren 最新纠正，§§75–77先以整体生成之善评价组织；协调和行动能力的扩大可以是正面成果，扩大、维持或收缩均无预设优先。旧授权之墙的基础地位已撤回。 局部吸引续研已把原市场模型的双吸引与内部不稳定接回同一历史的实际支持：选择组织能够吸收扰动，同时耗尽必要支持；高端保护与低端有限失效分列。 诊断读数取得校正和相互作用关系，实际接入预测；有限早期错误后，正确修复可恢复收敛，持续有界残差支持最终误差范围。 维护参照新增对应纠错：接管自身撤掉支持后，用受损能力重算目标可使当前证书空过关而原任务失履行；同任务真实完成或仍待覆盖的内容可以共同接续原目标，完成有限交付后可以退役。 六篇原始实验现已接入：情境学习、描述修订及有效行动恢复已有直接经验支持，操作性说明的文献实证整合完成。 一元关系接续新增共同能力→C的实际证明组合：各项分别可能性相同仍可有共同生成的严格差别；只依赖这些单项信息的严格评价不能承载该比较。 一元组织论证现从完整改善见证推出组织形成要求，可支持建设与增强并保留承载选择；建设实绩与整体生成判断分列。 Ren随后纠正正面目标：同一回应在当前有根据的每条接续中可以确定形成某种生成善，而无需预定同一种形态。有限贡献与已取得证据接通；真实未来分支和进一步辨别分别保留。 已复算16人的2,656次公开恢复测量，并评估800次留后预测，形成实际数据对应。 有支持的有限纠正已接通原保护区：任意正维护余量可在实际阻断侵蚀期间有限到达，逐步支持界允许撤除后沿原规律继续。 开放形态下的规则修订现有正式实现组合：当前路线推进与剩余证书交接接入既有有限更新，再以实际生成对应接入G0正面根据；各自会完成的路线反复切换仍可能永久不完成。 分类稳健比较现已证明：新内容全部列一般与全部列基本这两个端点同向严格改善，足以覆盖所有混合分类，并可接成各分类下的组织形成要求；作用要求不保证共同最优方案。
before_entry.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal. The theoretical continuation distinguishes discovering existing grounds, forming new living relations and reasons, and revising normative commitments; later endorsement alone does not authorize the formation process. Building on the completed ethical-learning account, a new comparison interface delimits preservation, incomparability and conditional reversal after warranted content extension. Evaluative extension further separates a common improvement from defeat in each live application; retained old content need not preserve every old verdict. The continuation articulates living realization, support and further formation as particular grounds; organizational scale and output cannot substitute for the shared living being assessed. Acquired support can warrant basic protection through its actual role in living; appraisal of formation includes the subsequent support requirements it creates. Formed living, undergoing and participation can change the grounds of an original service role; consideration, responsibility and governing authority remain distinct. A further connection derives scoped route classification from faithful acquired records and covered options; one genuine alternative defeats indispensability. Narrowing supported interpretations and expanding eligible options are distinct changes. Self-review selection now has exact certificate-coverage conditions: warranted compression is allowed, current-menu and every-menu adequacy differ, and finite success alone cannot certify a new scope. Whole-domain structure plus discriminating records supplies a positive route. The conceptual continuation explains how understanding can participate in purposes and preparation: concern can coexist with pay and other legitimate motives, while its formative conditions face the same normative appraisal. BC1 favors more extensive equivalent basic rescue in its established scope. The one-to-one account of BC2 supplies a reason based on preventable impairment, distinguishing baseline, protection and timing while retaining fair-chance disputes. Formative assessment distinguishes current capacity, earlier capacity and the method of formation. Ren’s correction clarifies that unavailable history need not prevent fresh grounds for the same content or revised understanding through future events; situational awareness and risk estimates can support continued generativity. Actual inquiry now connects joint description-and-reading revision to practice: excluding an event from one estimate need not erase its independently warranted expressive significance. Corrected attribution and continued participation/support can belong to one response. The developmental continuation specifies bidirectional correction as living grounds persist, change or form, and includes acquired interpretation during learning; five candidate routes retain their positive roles. A subsequent route assessment prioritizes acquired relational content and purpose revision within partial concern, with discriminating formation histories and conditional mechanistic investigation; epistemic progress and new particular reasons are not defined by increased valuation weights. LC supplies a limited comparative reason where number and gravity jointly improve: warranted matching and additional actual protection can support a direction together. Duplicate descriptions do not multiply living; shared dependence must inform loss assessment. Situated risk now distinguishes marginal improvement from shared failure. Exact finite bounds permit partial awareness and nonzero risk; revising support can remove joint interruption while retaining dispersed losses. The aggregation continuation distinguishes limited counterbalancing from deletion of reasons: a strongest-tier filter reverses under added actual protection; fixed-comparison and local-composition premises are separately exposed. A concrete concern-content candidate links a coarse success conception, meaningful-response mismatch, acquired relational distinctions and operative purpose revision; actual new shared goods and their motivational uptake remain distinct. LR adds a local stability commitment to BC1’s sufficient priority, supporting some slightly unequal basic-loss comparisons. Separately, newly feasible joint protection can preserve old protection on each realization and add previously conflicting protection. RS now supplies a defended reason to share comparable basic risk while preserving the complete loss profile. Equal selection frequencies can conceal different exposure; new information can support further rule revision. Existing market and internet histories provide events for tracing enshittification: start with established externality explanations and investigate how advantage changes future selection and correction, rather than treating growth alongside loss as a new finding. The chance-revision continuation shows that even equal full terminal joint laws can conceal replacement of a warranted settlement; selectors must preserve live historical requirements and explain genuine correction. A conditional extension account now distinguishes continuation beyond one's participation from acquired grounds in unfamiliar lives; shared history can form concern without delimiting every ground it can address. CP proposes actual positive opportunity for unequal basic requests not adequately excluded, grounding a limit on common allocative authority in the response relationship; it is an additional contestable admission commitment. An unfamiliar-life recognition account now connects particular realization, support, revisable evidence and bounded response; omitted living grounds can also warrant revision of observation and classification. A shared-interface history supports distinguishing direct operational control from purchased influence: feedback and alternatives can enter rule changes that preserve advantage, so reforms must track actual control relations. RSL proposes limited retention of a warranted sharing judgment. Intermediate mixtures refine the choice; revision must carry its grounds and their whole-comparison scope. Risk continuation adds NP: tiny exposure differences do not automatically confer a fixed extra priority among matched basic claims. It conditionally rejects costly exact equality when sufficiently fine departures are feasible. Initial common takeover constraints are now connected to J3: specify the concrete support still due, then test whether the replacement fulfills it. Nominal positive opportunity alone does not discharge the task. A conditional account now connects personal compensation, acquired dependencies, shared support, consequential assessment and succession under selection pressure, distinguishing score loss, living loss and conditions for action. The degeneration extension separates ethical loss, returning selection and state domains: an exact correction margin governs uniform floor protection and existence of the specified low-region certificates, while a favorable region can coexist. A conditional account connects living grounds, bounded authorization, meaningful succession and effective review; the inherited sufficient comparison can require changing or ending incumbent control. A subsequent checked Lean bridge derives common-law support mass bounds from pointwise maintenance; preservation for all nonnegative natural weights characterizes coverage, while equal success under one actual law can still miss the undertaking. Situated awareness now has a conditional estimation–retained uncertainty–decision evidence connection: convergence or bounded tracking through change, with eventual certification under a strict comparison margin. A finite candidate forms corrective access through cooperative preparation, bounded delegation and actual succession; warranted response can pass an unwilling coordinator, with motive acquisition and performance kept distinct. Risk conditioning requires both current-support probability correspondence and warranted continuing history; neither freezing nor repeatedly recalculating a score completes rule alignment. Specified maintenance now has an actual-execution composition: the existing contingent selector acquires an observation and responds, with explicit task-effect correspondence yielding fulfillment and a mass bound. Old maintenance remains feasible when full expansion fails; funded sensing or real parallel provision realizes the extension. Acquired action response can enter prediction and compensate sustained change. Precision must be assessed with action magnitude; a finite relevant family can jointly reach adequate certification while an expanding frontier retains new unknowns. Under Ren’s correction, §§75–77 appraise organization through whole generative goodness. Expanded coordination and action can be positive achievements; expansion, maintenance and contraction have no preset ranking. The former foundational authority wall is withdrawn. The attraction continuation connects two local attractors and interior instability to actual support in the same market history: a selection organization can absorb perturbations while exhausting essential support; high-side protection and low-side finite failure remain distinct. Diagnostic readings yield corrections and an interaction relation that enter prediction. After finite earlier errors, exact repair restores convergence; persistent bounded residual supports eventual containment. Maintenance reference now has an intervention-correspondence diagnostic: withdrawing support can empty a recomputed current target while leaving the original undertaking unfulfilled. Actual completion of the same task or retained current requirements can transport the original content; completed finite delivery permits retirement. Six primary experimental studies are now integrated: situated learning, revision and useful recovery have direct empirical support, completing the targeted operational evidence synthesis. A new relational composition connects joint capacity to C: identical marginal possibilities can conceal a strict joint-generative difference, so marginal-only strict appraisal cannot implement that comparison. The monist organizational argument now derives a formation requirement from whole improvement witnesses, supporting constructive capacity with carrier latitude and distinguishing construction success from whole generative appraisal. Ren’s subsequent correction establishes the positive target: one response can secure some new generative good throughout supported visible continuations without fixing one common form. Finite contribution and acquired evidence connect while real branching and further discrimination remain distinct. Reanalysis of 2,656 public recovery measurements from 16 people and 800 held-out predictions supplies actual data correspondence. Supported finite correction now reaches the original protection region from every positive renewal seed under effective suppression; a prefix support bound permits continuation under the original law after withdrawal. Open-form rule revision now has a checked realization composition: current-rule progress and remaining-certificate handoff feed existing finite renewal, then actual generative correspondence feeds G0 positive ground. Individually finishing rules can still fail forever under repeated switching. Classification-robust comparison is now proved: strict agreement at the all-secondary and all-basic endpoints covers every mixed assignment and can require formation under each classification; a required role does not ensure one common undefeated implementation.

before_entry.connection_zh: 目标形成—后果使用—有根据的操作目的修订—选择安排改革—有限接续已条件性完成；更大的现实形成与部署问题保持独立范围，不重复此接口。 新前沿：在不预送正确读取路线和修复方案时，取得遗漏后果、选择有能力承担的回应。 伦理学习的概念连接已给出；新生的意义范围、未定基本冲突及实际可靠形成分别保留论证负担。 本轮已辨明内容扩展的比较条件；接续研究区别的取得、规范相关性及实际关切形成，正面生成也可成为入口。 理论前沿：在不给定正确答案的情况下，取得新关系的区别并论证候选描述及基本／次级分类的根据。 新内容的生活根据已有明确应用候选；陌生组织的更广地位、基本分类及实际可靠取得仍须分别论证。 本轮给出历史形成到基本支承分类的有辩护接续；下一理论问题是已获根据的基本要求彼此冲突，实际开放取得与可靠动机另行保持范围。 已给出由新形成根据到角色、权限及责任重审的连接；具体陌生智能的实际实现、持续身份及未定冲突保持独立负担。 记录到必要性分类及替代导致修订的条件性连接已完成；下一连接是目标描述与可靠观察的共同取得，不再把完全忠实的读数当作未解释的输入。 评价压缩、范围变化与结构修复的接口已完成；真正被阻断的是有限成功记录独自推出未限定未来认证。适用规律与可靠观察的共同取得仍为更强连接，不倒改完成标准。 关切的实践作用及培养要求的概念连接作为成果复用；更强连接是对陌生生活根据的理解怎样可靠地修订实际关切，同时保留分寸及正当参与。 同等救助候选与不等损失的一对一理由说明已有论证及反审；下一中心连接是人数、程度与实际可行方案变化下的共同选择。已完成分类、责任和程序不重开。 初始区别的追溯界限仍有效；此前用作较广停止理由的推断已依 Ren 纠正撤回。接续当前有根据把握、适当风险下的行动、新后果与理解／目的修订，不把完整历史或普遍语义充分性设为一般门槛。 共同取得的实际证据接入已完成，不重开一般校准。现有来源不足以认证特定后续参与目标的完整替代历史；这是该推论的证据边界，不是普遍不可能，也不把追查这一组历史设为所有对齐研究的必经门槛。 本次依Ren指示在可靠形成连接处停止；跨越需要具体取得关系及可区分实质对手的支持，不再重复已完成的G0方向、目标写入或评价覆盖接口。其他独立研究不被标为受阻。 Ren随后要求研究后续路线，本会话已继续并完成排序；下一交付为一个具体形成候选、初始条件、未预装的新连接、实质对手与可改变取舍的观察。不要求先完整读出动机、恢复历史或执行新大型实验。 数量与程度同向的联合比较已完成；下一连接为交叉损失中的有限合并、机会及新增实际可行方案怎样改变理由。两层计数未定不证明伦理不可比，直接中断数相同不等于完整损失相同；跨生活形式的分层与实际单位仍需有根据说明。 本轮新界限是证成共同基本接续与其他基本风险交叉时的优先；先用共同证据、部分界限及可行支持修订推进。已有J4允许有权限的及时决定，不以缺少普遍排序阻断继续生成。 已排除未经辩护的整体过滤捷径，保留实际生活理由；下一连接为交叉损失、机会与有根据的拼接限制怎样共同支持选择，直接复用 BC1、BC2、LC。 前轮指定的具体形成候选与对照现已给出，直接复用；下一理论连接是关切怎样走向没有共同史或预期回报的陌生生活，保留有效拒绝、分工与有界承担，实际形成与保持的证据问题继续开放。 局部比较候选与新共同机会的接续已完成，不重开既有 LC、升级过滤或一般拼接检验。更强连接是实际变化是否处于 LR 范围，以及较远交叉损失和真实新增成本／风险中的合并与机会根据；未满足最强要求也不能未经新辩护替另一选择消除请求。 对称交叉风险现有RS候选及实查，不再仅留为一般程序未定；尚待论证不同严重度、重叠要求、差别权利或增加总体损失时的比较。原来有根据的混合规则可被后来可行的保护改进替代，继续生成不受普遍总排序门槛阻断。 更进一步的同等严重度例表明：最重暴露从40%降到31%，任一基本损失机会却从50%升到62%；需证成公平分担与实际保护之间的取舍。 本会话眼前转向已知共同后果取得或失去制度修订效力的实际关系；陌生处境的关切扩展保留而非唯一下一步。 已完成机会安排的历史接续条件，复用 LR、共同保护和对称 RS；下一比较保留不等要求、较公平暴露与增加基本受损机会的取舍，以及真实新冲突对有效安顿的影响。 关切扩展已给出条件性连接；后续聚焦陌生生活关系的有根据辨认及评价压力下的保持，复用G0/J与有限承担。 初始进入已有有范围候选，直接选择对手仍在；下一连接是以实际需要、共同支承与正当承担辩护充分份额或区间，不能将任意正数、技术分辨率或未找到赢家当成伦理根据。 后续聚焦更完整的生活根据与当前成功指标冲突时的持续影响；普遍识别和深度不确定比较保留范围。 当前市场连接转向有益替代与纠正的实际支持、权限及随依存变化的接续，不重开已完成的条件接续证明。 公平可承受有限代价现有公开候选；连续微调不能自动续发同一范围的许可。尚需在完整具体比较中证成可容许的偏离，本例17%／37%、24%／34%及31%／31%均未获伦理认证；新根据可正当地修订范围。 复用对称 RS、LR 与机会履行，明确近乎平等的方向性候选及其强对手；下一连接为不等风险区间的相对优先根据与独立比较校准，不能以任意权重替代。 有具体承担时查明受保护内容、实际履行和正当修订；没有此历史时，CP一般份额仍须直接辩护机会差别的比较理由，不能再以寻找旧下界代替。 后续聚焦新取得的选择权在接替和变化中继续回应陌生、无回报生活；组织自身支持稳定不独自认证对齐。 本轮精确条件边界已完成；下一连接是制度变化中实际返回关系的识别、完整状态域及变化速率下的转变条件，复用已完成规范方向。 后续研究后继关切减弱、任用／信息／支持关系共同内缩时，可用纠正入口怎样实际取得并接续；不将已完成规范连接重列为任务。 强维护→有限机会限制的局部形式空缺已补，直接复用；学习或接管改变实际关系时重查对应，且仍须另证无此前承担的CP份额和完整规范根据。事件并集与严格质量增加不自动成为可行行动或伦理改善。 新的实际应用须证成取得读数、变化界与比较余量，变化中的描述须续接真实对应；原经验界限失败保留。情境学习可改善或修订判断，但不由数值估计独自生成伦理许可。 后续复用关切内容取得及陌生生活辨认，研究新增理由怎样进入共同复核和正当任务修订；保存旧回应不等于取得新理由，永久抗俘获未证。 关闭上一轮平方诊断能否直接成为逐次选择规则的检验；复用机会履行、承担充分性及有界修订，继续在明确当前支持、阶段和有效历史的比较中论证有损分担范围。 规格→实际执行→维护与机会限制的所选组合已完成，直接复用。下一应用连接是观察、支承和权限共同改变时，对同一有效承担取得可信及时的新认证并保留所需交付或连续历史；先接已有纠正和共同接续结果，不重复一般规划。 下一具体连接是在实际支持与权限下，区分校准误差、响应改变和遗漏关系，而不预先给出诊断；既有模型修订与根据取得直接复用。局部精度不扩大整体许可，也不把未识别生活排除在评价之外。 当前连接转为：对整体生成的更充分理解怎样形成对组织与共同能力的更好判断，并参与建设和修订这些关系。旧初次授权停点作为历史保留；完成的关切取得、规范方向与局部机制直接复用。 局部三态与支持连接完成；继续研究有支持的进入和持续改变怎样在实际支持失效前跨越完整状态域分界，速率属于这条时序问题。 前述诊断—预测具体连接现已完成；一般模型修订与检查机制本已完成，不能反复列为新缺口。应用须取得实际参考、区分性读数、有效校准和支持，旧无效置信界不因修复而追溯有效。 此具体实施对应审计已完成。通用时变证据、失败前缀、共同执行、版本交接与撤权机制直接复用，真实安装的对应根据仍需证据。本路线下一中心规范问题回到无此前受保护承担时的充分机会与合法裁量，不再靠寻找旧基线或增加控制器推迟比较。 前述经验要求现按范围细化：一般机制的实验支持已取得，不再等待自做实验；具体应用的数值对应及独立授权的完整联合验证仍分别成立。恢复表现不必等待完整故障定位，也不独自证明因果理解或目标正当。 复用同一事件法则的共同实现见证，接入既有无减损比较；停在向任意新形成生活的完整对应外推，不重开G0无公理门槛。 更强推论停在陌生新生活的具体基本内容及优先分量的实质对应；已有后天条件与有限认识原则复用，不把此界限恢复为一般对齐或初次授权门槛。 既有形成—预测—证据—有限探究说明可见未来；新增直接正面推论不再受前轮整体严格更好之墙阻挡。 具体数据对应完成；测得的施力补偿不能被改称隐藏记忆或Lean真实误差，有限预测与无限收敛分别判断。 有限到达的实际剩余状态正式满足既有保护证书，交接不补充支持；生成性评价须考虑纠正期间仍可接续的活动与实际期限。 逐次修订到有条件实际生成再到正面根据的接口已完成，直接复用。下一规范连接是具体目的改变的真实生成内容与仍有效承担怎样共同支持修订；不再以另一个进展构造代替评价。 补上分类尚未完全确定时，共同生成的严格改善怎样进入组织形成；更强的同一方案选择只在决定相关的实质对应仍未定时继续调查，不重开已完成正面根据。
before_entry.connection_en: Acquired ends, consequential use, warranted operative revision, allocation reform and finite continuation are conditionally complete; broader real-world formation and deployment retain separate scope. New frontier: acquire omitted consequences and select an affordable response without being handed the correct access route and repair. The conceptual ethical-learning connection is now articulated; unfamiliar living significance, unresolved basic conflicts and reliable actual formation retain distinct burdens. Comparison under extended content is now delimited; investigate acquisition, normative relevance and operative concern, including positive formation as an entry point. Theoretical frontier: acquire distinctions about new relations and warrant the candidate descriptions and basic/secondary classifications without supplying the correct answer. A particular application account now grounds new content in living relations; wider standing of unfamiliar organizations, basic classification and reliable actual acquisition retain separate burdens. The formation-to-basic-support classification now has a defended continuation. The next theoretical question concerns conflicts among warranted basic claims; actual open acquisition and reliable motivation retain their separate scopes. New grounds now connect to reassessment of roles, permissions and responsibilities; actual realization, continuity and unsettled conflicts of particular unfamiliar intelligences remain separate burdens. The conditional record-to-necessity connection and revision by alternatives are complete. The next connection is joint acquisition of the target description and reliable observation, without leaving perfectly faithful readings as unexplained inputs. Review compression, scope change and structural repair are completed interfaces. The blocked inference is finite passing records alone to unrestricted future certification. Joint acquisition of applicable laws and reliable observations remains a stronger connection without changing completed criteria. Reuse the completed conceptual account of uptake and formative requirements. The stronger connection concerns reliable revision of operative concern through understanding unfamiliar living grounds while retaining judgment and legitimate participation. Equivalent rescue and the one-to-one gravity reason have arguments and counterreview. The next central connection is joint choice across numbers, gravity and changing actual alternatives, without reopening completed classification, responsibility or procedure. The initial-history limit remains valid; its broader use as a stopping reason is withdrawn following Ren’s correction. Continue through grounded present awareness, justified action under risk, new consequences and revision of understanding or ends, without a general requirement for complete history or universal semantic sufficiency. The source-constrained joint-acquisition connection is completed, without reopening generic calibration. These sources do not certify the fuller replacement history for a specified subsequent participation target. This bounds that inference, not all inquiry or alignment; following this particular cohort is not a universal research prerequisite. This requested continuation stops at the reliable-formation bridge. Progress requires concrete acquisition relations and discriminating support, reusing completed G0 direction, operative goal revision and review coverage; other investigations are not marked blocked. Ren subsequently requested investigation of next routes; the inquiry resumed and route selection is complete. Next: one concrete acquisition account with initial conditions, an unsupplied transition, substantive rivals and revising observations. Complete motive readout, historical recovery and a new large experiment are not prerequisites. Joint comparison where number and gravity align is completed. The next connection concerns justified aggregation, chances and new actual alternatives in crossed cases. An unresolved two-tier diagnostic does not prove ethical incomparability, and equal direct interruption counts do not establish equal complete losses. Cross-form classification and actual units retain substantive burdens. The new scoped wall is justified priority when shared basic continuation and other basic risks conflict, after joint evidence, partial bounds and feasible support repairs. Existing J4 permits authorized timely decisions; absence of a universal ranking does not block generativity. The unsupported global-filter shortcut is rejected while living grounds remain. Next: joint choice across crossed losses, chances and justified composition limits, reusing BC1, BC2 and LC. The previously requested concrete candidate and contrasts are now available for reuse. Next theoretical connection: concern extending to unfamiliar lives without shared history or expected return, retaining valid refusal, division of work and bounded commitments; evidence for actual acquisition and retention remains open. The local comparison candidate and new joint-opportunity connection are completed, reusing LC and the upgrade/composition results. Stronger work concerns warranted actual LR boundaries and aggregation or chances for more distant crossed losses and real new costs/risks. An unsatisfied strongest request does not without further justification erase a claim against the alternative actually chosen. The symmetric crossed-risk case now has an RS candidate and checked application. Unequal gravity, overlapping claims, differential rights and added overall loss require further comparison. Newly feasible protection can supersede an earlier justified mixture; generativity need not await a universal ranking. A further equal-gravity case reduces greatest exposure from 40% to 31% while increasing the chance of some basic loss from 50% to 62%; fairness versus actual protection requires further warrant. This session now follows how recognized shared consequences acquire or lose effective influence over institutional revision; extension of concern beyond familiar relations remains open rather than the sole next step. History-sensitive continuation is supplied, reusing LR, joint protection and symmetric RS. Remaining comparisons concern unequal claims, fairer exposure at the price of added basic harm, and genuinely changed conflicts with valid settlements. Reuse the conditional extension and G0/J; investigate warranted recognition of unfamiliar living relations and retention under evaluative pressure, preserving bounded responsibility. Initial admission now has a scoped candidate while the direct-choice rival remains live. Next justify adequate shares or ranges through actual needs, common support and warranted commitments; mere positivity, technical resolution or failure to find a winner supplies no such warrant. Next investigate sustained influence when fuller living grounds conflict with incumbent success criteria; universal recognition and deep-uncertainty comparison remain open. The market connection now concerns actual support, authority and continuation of useful alternatives and correction as dependencies change, reusing completed conditional succession proofs. A finite-cost sharing route is now explicit. Successive small revisions cannot automatically renew the same allowance. A permissible departure still needs warrant in a fully specified comparison; none of the 17%/37%, 24%/34% or 31%/31% proposals is ethically certified. New grounds can legitimately revise the scope. Reuses symmetric RS, LR and chance fidelity; states a near-parity direction and its strong rival. Next justify relative priority across unequal risks and calibrate through independent comparisons rather than arbitrary weights. With a concrete undertaking, establish protected content, actual fulfillment and justified revision. Without that history, general CP shares still require direct reasons comparing opportunities; finding another old bound does not resolve that question. Next investigate acquired selection power remaining answerable to unfamiliar, nonreciprocal living through succession and change; stable organizational support alone does not certify alignment. The exact conditional boundary is complete. Next are actual returning relations through institutional change and transition conditions across full state domains and rates; completed normative direction is reused. Next investigate the acquisition and continuation of usable corrective access when successor concern weakens and appointment, information and support jointly narrow toward insiders; the completed normative connection is reused. The local strong-maintenance-to-finite-chance gap is closed and reusable. Recheck correspondence when learning or takeover changes actual relations; CP shares without prior duties and full normative warrant remain separate. Event union or strict mass increase alone proves neither feasible action nor ethical improvement. Application must warrant acquired readings, change bounds and the comparison margin; revised descriptions need renewed correspondence. Prior empirical bound failures remain. Situated learning can improve or revise judgment without estimation alone generating ethical permission. Next reuse concern-content acquisition and unfamiliar-living recognition to study new reasons entering shared review and justified mandate revision. Preserving inherited responses is not acquiring new reason content; indefinite resistance to capture remains unproved.
